<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Internship"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/internship">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Decision" name="Offer decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CompanyStatus" name="Status update about student"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StudentStatus" name="Status update about internship"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends (via Twitter)"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Offer" name="Offer" messageRef="Msg_Offer"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Decision" name="Offer decision" messageRef="Msg_Decision"
                      sourceRef="Task_DecideOffer" targetRef="Participant_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CompanyStatus" name="Status update about student" messageRef="Msg_CompanyStatus"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCompanyStatus"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StudentStatus" name="Status update about internship" messageRef="Msg_StudentStatus"
                      sourceRef="Task_WriteStatus" targetRef="Participant_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet" messageRef="Msg_Tweet"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendTweet" targetRef="Participant_Friends"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Student internship process" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Search" name="Start internship search"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPreferences" name="Enter topic, desired salary, experience and hobbies"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferMerge" name="Waiting for offers"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OfferReceived" name="Offer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OfferReceived" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideOffer" name="Accept or deny offer"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Offer accepted?"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOthers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusSplit" name="Internship running"/>

    <!-- Student status update loop -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentMerge" name="Status update due"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WriteStatus" name="Write status update about internship"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentCheck" name="At least 3 status updates written?"/>

    <!-- Company status update loop -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyMerge" name="Company update due"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCompanyStatus" name="Receive status update about student"
                      messageRef="Msg_CompanyStatus"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CompanyCheck" name="At least 3 company updates received?"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusJoin" name="Internship finished"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTweet" name="Send recommendation tweet to friend" messageRef="Msg_Tweet">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics id="MI_Tweets" isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Done" name="Recommendations sent"/>

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_Search" targetRef="Task_EnterPreferences"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preferences" sourceRef="Task_EnterPreferences" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferMerge" targetRef="Event_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferToDecision" sourceRef="Event_OfferReceived" targetRef="Task_DecideOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DecisionGateway" sourceRef="Task_DecideOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOthers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Denied" name="Denied" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Gateway_OfferMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvalidateToSplit" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOthers" targetRef="Gateway_StatusSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToStudent" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusSplit" targetRef="Gateway_StudentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToCompany" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusSplit" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StudentMergeToWrite" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentMerge" targetRef="Task_WriteStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteToStudentCheck" sourceRef="Task_WriteStatus" targetRef="Gateway_StudentCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StudentRepeat" name="Fewer than 3" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentCheck" targetRef="Gateway_StudentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StudentDone" name="3 or more" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentCheck" targetRef="Gateway_StatusJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyMergeToReceive" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCompanyStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToCompanyCheck" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCompanyStatus" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyRepeat" name="Fewer than 3" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyCheck" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyDone" name="3 or more" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyCheck" targetRef="Gateway_StatusJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToTweets" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusJoin" targetRef="Task_SendTweet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetsToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendTweet" targetRef="EndEvent_Done"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
